summary: Implemented prepareUpdate and the Update container in the rdflib SPARQL plugin. Changes: Update(prologue, algebra) class in rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py; translateUpdate in algebra.py builds the translated prologue from the first declaration group before the empty-request exit and returns an Update on every path; evalUpdate in update.py iterates update.algebra; prepareUpdate added to processor.py and exported from the sparql package __init__.py; new test/test_sparql_prepare.py covers the required behaviors including a no-mutation check. No tests were run, per instructions, so everything is verified by reading only. Not committed. Open item: the debug-only pprintAlgebra(pq) call in test/test_dawg.py receives the container now and may need .algebra; left unchanged as out of scope.
